deadline.value: The College of Engineering and Computing priority funding deadline for fall entry is December 1; the standard deadline is March 15.

gre_general.value: The catalog and department page do not mention the GRE.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The pages reviewed do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The pages reviewed do not describe PhD funding for statistics.

entry_route.value: Applicants may hold a bachelor's or a master's degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science or a related discipline.
entry_route.quote: We welcome applications to our PhD program from students with a bachelor's or a master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science

toefl_min.value: College of Engineering and Computing programs accept TOEFL 4.5 (new scale) with no section minimum, or 80 for tests taken before January 21, 2026.
toefl_min.quote: College of Engineering and Computing graduate and undergraduate applicant score requirement: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 4.5 (80 if test is before January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.value: College of Engineering and Computing programs accept an IELTS overall band of 6.5 with no section minimum.
ielts_min.quote: College of Engineering and Computing graduate and undergraduate applicant score requirement: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 4.5 (80 if test is before January 21, 2026)

notes: Admitted through the College of Engineering and Computing, so the CEC English rule applies. Deadlines are the college's; the department's own page lists dates from the 2025 cycle.
